questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Despair
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Faith**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__

 
• The word **"Despair"** means a complete loss or absence of hope. (निराशा)

 

 
• **Example: **After failing the exam, she was filled with despair.

 

 

 
• **"Faith" **refers to a strong belief or trust in something or someone, especially without proof. It represents hope and confidence, which is the opposite of despair. (आस्था)

 

 
• **Example: **Despite the challenges, he had faith that everything would work out in the end.

 

 

 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'despair' **is **'faith'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Faith**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Clumsy **(अकुशल): Lacking skill or grace in movement or action.

 

 
• **Example:** The clumsy waiter dropped the tray of dishes.

 

 

 
• **Appear **(प्रकट होना ): To come into view or become visible.

 

 
• **Example: **He appeared suddenly out of nowhere, startling everyone.

 

 

 
• **Incline** (झुकाव): To lean or bend toward a particular direction or to have a tendency toward something.

 

 
• **Example:** She inclined her head to listen more closely to the speaker.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the highlighted word in the given sentence to fill in the blank.

The nature of these two brothers is different. One is __**arrogant**__ whereas the other one is ____________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. Humble**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"arrogant"** means having an exaggerated sense of one's own importance or abilities; showing an overbearing attitude. (घमंडी)

 
 
• **Example:** His arrogant behavior alienated him from his colleagues.
 
 
 
• The word **"humble"** refers to someone who has or shows a modest or low estimation of their importance; opposite of arrogance. (विनम्र)
 
 
• **Example:** Despite his success, he remains humble and approachable.
 
 
 
• Since the sentence contrasts "arrogant" with its opposite, the correct antonym is **"humble."**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. Humble**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Better** (बेहतर): Of superior quality or excellence.

 
 
• **Example:** She always strives to do better than her previous performance.
 
 
 
• **Rude** (असभ्य): Lacking manners or courtesy; impolite.
 
 
• **Example:** His rude remarks offended everyone in the meeting.
 
 
 
• **Honest** (ईमानदार): Being truthful and sincere.
 
 
• **Example:** An honest person always earns the respect of others.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate phrase that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence without altering the sentence's meaning.

The CEO's decision to restructure the company was seen as __a bold move__ to stay competitive.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "**bold move**" in the sentence suggests a decision that is daring or courageous, which aligns with the meaning of "**daring step**."

Therefore, the most appropriate substitution is "**daring step**," making **Option 2** the correct choice.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The CEO's decision to restructure the company was seen as a daring step to stay competitive."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1 ("timid action") is incorrect because it conveys hesitation, which contradicts the boldness of the CEO's decision.
 
• Option 3 ("cautious approach") is also incorrect as it implies carefulness, which does not align with the daring nature of the decision.
 
• Option 4 ("predictable response") is incorrect because a bold move is often unexpected and not predictable.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Construct
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. Demolish.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Construct"** means to build or put together something, especially buildings or structures. (निर्माण करना)

 
 
• **Example: **The team worked hard to construct a new bridge over the river.
 
 
 
• **"Demolish" **refers to the act of destroying or tearing down something, especially buildings or structures. (ध्वस्त करना)
 
 
• **Example: **The old factory was demolished to make space for a new shopping mall.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Construct' **is **'Demolish'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Detect **(पता लगाना): To discover or identify the presence of something.

 
 
• **Example:** The scientist was able to detect traces of a rare element in the sample.
 
 
 
• **Proceed **(आगे बढ़ना): To continue or move forward in a course of action.
 
 
• **Example:** After the interruption, the speaker proceeded with her presentation.
 
 
 
• **Compensate **(क्षतिपूर्ति करना): To make up for something, especially a loss or deficiency.
 
 
• **Example:** The company promised to compensate the workers for their extra hours of work.

Select the most appropriate idiom that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Despite the initial setbacks, the team remained __optimistic and pushed__ through to achieve their goals.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2, kept their chin up**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

• **"Kept their chin up"** means to remain cheerful and optimistic, especially in difficult situations. (मुश्किल परिस्थितियों में उत्साहित और आशावादी रहना)

 
 
• **Example:** Even after losing the match, the players kept their chin up and prepared for the next game.
 
 
 
• In the given sentence, "Despite the initial setbacks, the team remained optimistic and pushed through to achieve their goals," the idiom "kept their chin up" perfectly substitutes the underlined segment as it conveys the idea of staying positive in challenging times.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2, kept their chin up**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Kept at bay** (दूर रखना): To keep something or someone at a safe distance or to prevent something from happening.

 
 
• **Example:** The villagers built a strong fence to keep the wild animals at bay.
 
 
 
• **Kept a close eye** (नज़दीकी से निगरानी रखना): To monitor someone or something carefully.
 
 
• **Example:** The teacher kept a close eye on the students during the exam.
 
 
 
• **Kept a stiff upper lip** (दृढ़ और शांत रहना): To remain strong and not show emotions, especially in difficult situations.
 
 
• **Example:** Even after hearing the bad news, she kept a stiff upper lip and supported her family.

questions.question:
The given sentence is divided into four segments. Select the option that has the segment with an adverbial usage error.

Lily and her mother / brightly handled / the difficult / situation.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The adverb "**brightly**" is incorrectly used in the sentence.
 
• Adverbs typically modify verbs, adjectives, or other adverbs, and their usage should align with the meaning of the sentence.
 
• In this context, "**brightly handled**" is not appropriate. Instead, a more suitable adverb like "**skillfully**" or "**gracefully**" should be used to describe how the situation was managed.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **Option 2**.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Lily and her mother skillfully handled the difficult situation."*

The museum's collection features both modern and __antiquated __artifacts, showcasing the evolution of art over the centuries.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1 (Contemporary)**.

• The word **"antiquated"** means outdated, old-fashioned, or belonging to an earlier period in time. (पुरातन)

 
 
• **Example:** The company decided to replace its antiquated machinery with modern equipment.
 
 
 
• The word **"Contemporary"** refers to something that is modern, current, or belonging to the same time period as the present. (आधुनिक)
 
 
• **Example:** The artist is known for his contemporary style of painting that resonates with today's audience.
 
 
 
• Hence, the antonym of **"antiquated"** is **"contemporary."**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1 (Contemporary)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Obsolete** (प्रचलन से बाहर): No longer in use or outdated.

 
 
• **Example:** Many believe that printed newspapers will soon become obsolete due to digital media.
 
 
 
• **Outdated** (पुराना): Something old-fashioned or no longer relevant.
 
 
• **Example:** The software is outdated and needs to be upgraded.
 
 
 
• **Ancient** (प्राचीन): Belonging to a very distant past, often thousands of years old.
 
 
• **Example:** The ancient ruins of the city attract tourists from around the world.

(A) While teaching, / (B) she draws the diagrams very careful / (C) on the board.
questions.solution:

• The word "**careful**" is an adjective, but the sentence requires an adverb to describe the action of drawing diagrams.
 
• The correct word should be "**carefully**", which is an adverb and modifies the verb "**draws**" appropriately.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. Determine the collocation through the sentence.

The drowning fisherman waved his hands ___________ to get the attention of the rescue team.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**frantically**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

• The word "**frantically**" means in a hurried, excited, or disorganized manner, often due to fear or urgency. (उत्तेजित होकर)
 
• The drowning fisherman needed to attract the attention of the rescue team, so he waved "frantically" in desperation.
 
• The other options: "**strongly**," "**softly**," and "**poorly**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *The drowning fisherman waved his hands frantically__ to get the attention of the rescue team.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Strongly (मजबूती से)**: implies with great force or intensity, but does not convey urgency or desperation.
 
• **Softly (धीरे से)**: implies in a gentle or quiet manner, which is not suitable for the context.
 
• **Poorly (खराब तरीके से)**: means inadequately or badly, which does not fit the given situation.
